name: Authority Invariant Test Suite
description: Property-based tests that assert authority invariants: no privilege escalation, no receipt without evidence, no approval without quorum.
acceptanceCriteria: Property-based tests cover: no privilege escalation, no receipt without evidence, no approval without quorum.
Tests generate random valid and invalid authority operations.
Invariants hold under concurrent execution scenarios.
Tests run in CI on every change to authority-related code.
New invariants can be added without modifying the test harness.
